title: US scalar weapons rumor

tellings.quote: they've told me second hand stuff suggesting that the US has developed what what are called scalar weapons.

plain: The United States has built what are called scalar weapons, a kind of weapon he names but does not describe, according to the journalist Ross Coulthart. He tells Michels this came to him second-hand from people he spoke with, and he gives no names, dates or details. If true, the US would hold a weapon the public knows nothing about.
